services.title: Areas of Practice
services.subtitle: Guidance and assistance in family law matters involving international elements.

internationalDivorce.title: International Divorce
internationalDivorce.description: Guidance on divorce matters involving different countries, including Brazilian nationals living abroad and international marriages.
areas: Divorce for Brazilian nationals living abroad
Recognition of foreign divorces in Brazil
Division of assets located in different countries

internationalCustody.title: International Custody & Parental Responsibility
internationalCustody.description: Assistance with custody, visitation, and parental responsibility matters when parents or children are located in different countries.
areas: Child custody when parents live in different countries
Relocation of a child to another country

internationalChildAbduction.title: International Child Abduction
internationalChildAbduction.description: Analysis and guidance in situations involving the international removal or retention of children.
areas: Determination of the child's habitual residence

internationalChildSupport.title: International Child Support
internationalChildSupport.description: Guidance on support matters when the responsible party or beneficiary resides in another country.
areas: Collection of support from a person living abroad

foreignFamilyDecisions.title: Recognition of Foreign Family Decisions
foreignFamilyDecisions.description: Guidance on having family court decisions recognized and given effect in another country.

internationalMarriage.title: International Marriage
internationalMarriage.description: Guidance for marriages involving different countries, nationalities, or international legal effects.
areas: Marriage between Brazilian and foreign nationals
Marriage celebrated in Brazil with effects abroad
Matrimonial property regimes and prenuptial agreements

internationalProperty.title: International Property & Matrimonial Regimes
internationalProperty.description: Case-by-case analysis of property matters involving marriages and families with connections to different countries.
areas: Law applicable to the matrimonial property regime

internationalFiliation.title: International Filiation
internationalFiliation.description: Guidance on parentage and documentation matters involving family or birth connections across different countries.
areas: Registration of foreign birth records in Brazil

internationalAdoption.title: International Adoption
internationalAdoption.description: Guidance on international adoption involving Brazilian nationals and matters concerning its effects in Brazil.
areas: Recognition of decisions and effects in Brazil

transnationalDomesticViolence.title: Domestic Violence in a Transnational Context
transnationalDomesticViolence.description: Guidance in domestic violence situations involving different countries and potentially affecting custody, return, or protection matters.
areas: Domestic violence in international custody disputes
